status: independent reference panel prepared; NOT an executed discovery benchmark

label_definition.3: strong product/use-case competitor for the stated query; does not assert equal price
label_definition.2: useful related competitor for part of query; limitations must be visible
label_definition.1: weak adjacency, accessory-only or materially different audience/position
label_definition.null: not enough evidence; do not silently count as irrelevant

limitations: Single analyst reference judgment, independent of StoreScout but not independent second human review.
Brands are grouped; 25 cases are not 25 independent niches. Group bootstrap/splits required.
Platform status and live catalog availability are separate unmeasured properties.
Two known references per case are insufficient to enumerate the market; returned results must be judged independently.
No synthetic rows are passed off as real index records.
NuPhy evidence older than most sources; refresh before scoring.
Owner wording and willingness to accept a competitor remain unvalidated.
